title: I Reincarnated As the Villainous Noble of an Otome Game, so I Tried Buying the Main Heroine With Money
description:
After being reincarnated into the world of an otome game, the protagonist discovers he is not one of the romanceable heroes, but a villainous noble destined for ruin.

Determined to escape his inevitable downfall, he comes up with an unconventional strategy: before the game’s story even begins, he uses his family’s immense wealth to rescue and effectively purchase the freedom of the game’s main heroine.

He hopes to protect her early and change the course of events, and avoid the tragic future awaiting him.
However, his kindness, resources, and unexpected actions begin to reshape the destinies of the heroines around him, leading to new relationships, political intrigue, and a story that diverges further and further from the original game scenario.
author: Iko
